text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan

(Pindaan) (No. 2) 2012.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 5 Oktober 2012.

Pindaan Jadual

2. (1) Perintah Had Laju Kebangsaan 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989] dipinda dalam

Jadual dengan memasukkan selepas butiran 17 butiran yang berikut:

 "18. Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur

Fasa 2 yang bermula dari kilometer 303.395 (di koordinat U

249377.2218, T 136811.5933 Grid Cassini Negeri Terengganu)

dan berakhir di kilometer 2.903 di Persimpangan Jalan Kg.

Chabang (di koordinat U 257350.5920, T 147997.3780 Grid

Cassini Negeri Terengganu)".

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMUR- FASA 2

Dibuat 3 Oktober 2012

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/11 Jld. 2; PN(PU2)460/LXVI ]

 DATO' SERI KONG CHO HA

 Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

NATIONAL SPEED LIMIT (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(1) of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the National Speed Limit (Amendment)

(No. 2) Order 2012.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 5 October 2012.

Amendment of Schedule

2. (1) The National Speed Limit Order 1989 [P.U. (A) 18/1989] is amended in

the Schedule by inserting after item 17 the following item:

"18. The part of the road known as the East Coast Expressway Phase 2

commencing from kilometre 303.395 (at coordinates

N 249377.2218, E 136811.5933 of the Terengganu State Cassini

Grid) and ending at kilometre 2.903 at Kg. Chabang Road Junction

(at coordinates N 257350.5920, E 147997.3780 of the Terengganu

State Cassini Grid)".

(2) The road with the speed limit as specified under subparagraph (1) is

shown on the map in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(2)]

MAP OF EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY -PHASE 2

Made 3 October 2012

[KKR.PUU.110-1/6/11 Jld. 2; PN(PU2)460/LXVI]

DATO' SERI KONG CHO HA

 Minister of Transport
